messages:
maya: Quick sync — SDK PR (https://git/repo/sdk/pull/412) is blocked on an API change in backend. API PR is https://git/repo/api/pull/827. Can runtime/console folks take a look? TL;DR: header auth migration + small response-shape tweak.

sam: Taking a look at the API PR now :eyes:

jordan: I can review the SDK, but we need a backward compatibility plan. Does SDK fall back to the old header?

maya: Yes — SDK has a feature-flagged fallback. Adding compat tests now. Snippet here:
```diff
- Authorization: Bearer <token>
+ X-Internal-Auth: token
```

eric: Console needs the response shape for `GET /models/list` — I'll open a tiny mapper in the console PR (https://git/repo/console/pull/99) if the API shape changes.

ciara: FYI the helm bump depends on runtime image tag from runtime CI. Runtime PR: https://git/repo/runtime/pull/211

release-bot: deploy queued for staging if all PRs merged in the 12:00-14:00 PDT window.

sam: Can we gate SDK merge until API is canary-deployed? Otherwise staging might break.

maya: Agreed. Proposed sequence: canary-deploy API -> SDK merge with feature flag on -> console rollout after canary is green. Scheduling window tomorrow 13:00 PDT.

jordan: I left comments on SDK PR re: unit tests and an integration assertion. Will re-approve once addressed.

eric: Console PR will need one frontend + one backend approval. @ciara can you handle backend approval when ready?

ciara: On it, will review by EOD and add thumbs if clean. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — I'll update release ticket #R-542 with the merge window and canary checklist. Ping here if anyone hits a blocker.
